china_race_dynamics.text:
We are in a fierce global race for AI dominance and industrial power, yet we struggle to build the basic infrastructure to power it. ⚡

Our foreign adversaries are moving ahead while Senate leadership lets petty midterm politics stall permitting reform. We risk ceding our global leadership because we tie our own hands.

deepseek.reason: The statement discusses a global AI race and foreign adversaries but does not name China or make China competition the target.
deepseek.confidence_reason: It clearly endorses an AI race, but the target specifically requires China race dynamics and China is not named.

astra.reason: The speaker prioritizes global AI competition but does not identify China as the competitor.
astra.confidence_reason: Identifying the unnamed foreign adversaries as China would require unsupported inference.
